transcript: I am not sleeping well. I never feel rested and I always wake up tired. Nothing seems to help and I do not enjoy anything I used to like.
I feel completely stuck. I cannot stop thinking about everything that went wrong. I am sad all the time and I have no energy.
I have been feeling pretty stable. Sleep is okay and I am not hopeless. I went for a walk and I enjoyed the weather.
Last weekend I visited my sister. We cooked dinner and I felt really happy. I am looking forward to seeing her again.
Some days are harder than others but I am managing. I try to keep a routine and I do not feel completely lost.
